reproduction_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
source /workspace/.onboarding/env.sh
export GEM_HOME=/workspace/ruby-v5-task/gems
export GEM_PATH=$GEM_HOME:/workspace/ruby-v5-task/deps/ruby/3.3.0:/workspace/.onboarding/sysroot/usr/share/rubygems-integration/all
export SDK_INSTALL_ROOT=/workspace/ruby-v5-task/gems
export LEGACY_CHEMINEE_LIB=/workspace/cheminee-ruby/lib
cd /workspace/ruby-v5-task/repo
# Explicit gem activation alone is insufficient when RUBYLIB shadows gem files.
# Put activated gem paths first and assert actual JSON code version before tests.
ruby -e 'gem "json", "3.1.0"; gem "logger", "1.7.0"; gem "timeout", "0.6.1"; gem "uri", "1.1.2"; gem "net-protocol", "0.4.0"; gem "net-http", "0.10.0"; $LOAD_PATH.unshift(*Gem.loaded_specs.values.flat_map(&:full_require_paths)); require "json"; abort "wrong JSON" unless JSON::VERSION == "3.1.0"; puts "JSON=#{JSON::VERSION}"; puts $LOADED_FEATURES.grep(/json.*\.(so|rb)$/); load "sdk/ruby/wire_test.rb"'
